text: ไม่ต้องพึ่งฟ้า
style: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written. A 23-year-old young master of the Wei clan, male: clear, arrogant and contemptuous; his voice tightens when Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Thai line): 得意，快，說完就停，不笑
